title: Protocols and IP Addressing
welcome_lead: From HTTP to DNS: meet the protocols that keep the internet humming.

Browser asks DNS for example.com, gets IP.

TCP handshake, HTTP GET, server replies, browser renders.

32 bits, written as four 8-bit octets.

Client broadcasts DISCOVER, server OFFERS an IP.

Client REQUESTS it, server ACKs - dynamic IP assigned.
